production_independent_verifier: Checks actual source and current projected known-GPU binding equations, retained bounds/types/objectives, actual fixed-history RHS, unchanged capacity, every integer histogram incidence/coefficient, zero mapping, and appended inequality against source/proof hashes.
production_adoption_scope: Already verified histogram count units or STAY-only units. Optional migration lanes and mixed singleton flow units are excluded even under zero migration in this first adopted family.
validity_conditions: All selected count variables are binary/integer and count whole jobs occupying the same site/time.
Each selected whole job requires an integer GPU gang of at least g_min>0.
Residual capacity is the unchanged integer capacity after fixed physical occupancy; other occupancy is nonnegative.
Use already verified histogram/STAY-only count variables only; retain mixed singleton flow unchanged.
proof: g_min*sum(counts)<=sum(actual GPU occupancy)<=unchanged residual capacity. Since sum(counts) is integer, rounding down the right side is valid for every integer feasible schedule.
